assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire, heritage and engineering constraints require official confirmation.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, statutory green control and setbacks remain unknown; design geometry is not an approval basis.

assumptions.statement: The preserved site boundary and three key-area polygons are repository provisional constraints.
assumptions.impact: All derived geometry and metrics must be regenerated when official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Bands, networks, footprints, public spaces, scenarios and phases are deterministic concept-design derivatives of the site polygon.
assumptions.impact: They demonstrate reproducible urban-design logic but do not assert existing conditions or settled implementation.
